areas.title: Performance areas
areas.intro: Performance areas and BAU ownership continue after the transformation ends: reviews, checks and KPI actuals go on.
areas.tableIntro: An area moves to BAU only with the receiving owner's accepted handover.
areas.emptyBody: Create a performance area to prepare its BAU handover.
areas.outlives: This area outlives its transformation: closing the transformation does not stop its reviews, checks or KPI actuals.
areas.reopenIntro: Reopening starts a new cycle. The earlier handover acceptance and closure date stay as they are.
areas.retireIntro: A retired area can no longer be changed.
areas.cyclesIntro: Every cycle with the accepted handover and the closure it followed, unchanged by later reopenings.

links.title: Linked KPIs and benefits
links.intro: On acceptance, routine ownership of linked KPIs and benefits moves to BAU.

handover.title: BAU handovers
handover.intro: A handover transfers routine ownership to the receiving business owner, who accepts or returns it.
handover.formIntro: A draft may be incomplete. Submission checks every item.
handover.receivingOwnerHint: The business owner who accepts the handover and takes routine ownership.
handover.controlsNote: Controls are the area's active controls; add them on the area page.
handover.openBacklog: Open improvement items of the area
handover.evidenceIntro: Link an evidence item of this transformation.
handover.acceptIntro: Accepting moves the area to BAU, transfers routine ownership to you and schedules the first recurring review.
handover.acceptanceNote: accepting this handover is the receiving owner's in-product business decision. It is not an engineering delivery gate.
handover.acceptedFinal: This handover is accepted. It is final and is never edited; a reopening starts a new cycle.
handover.receiverOnly: Only the receiving owner can accept or return this handover.
handover.needsAcceptRight: You are the receiving owner, but your role does not include accepting handovers.

controls.title: Controls and control checks
controls.intro: Controls generate periodic checks. A failed check opens one recovery action with an owner and a follow-up date.
controls.ownerHint: Without an owner, the area's BAU owner runs the checks.

checks.intro: Checks are scheduled automatically from each control's frequency.
checks.emptyBody: Checks appear when they are scheduled.
checks.recordIntro: A failed check needs a result note and opens one recovery action.

reviews.title: Recurring reviews
reviews.intro: Performance reviews continue after delivery and after the transformation is closed.
reviews.subject: Subject
reviews.signalHint: Choose Unknown when the data does not show the trend.
reviews.emptyBody: The first review is created when a handover is accepted.
reviews.scanNote: Each review is created up to 7 days before it is due, whatever the transformation's status. Only the assigned reviewer completes it.

improvement.title: Continuous-improvement backlog
improvement.intro: Improvement items from lessons, checks, reviews and handovers.
improvement.afterClosure: Items stay visible and editable after the transformation is closed.

lessons.title: Lessons learned
lessons.intro: Lessons of this transformation. Published lessons are searchable from other transformations.
lessons.tagsHint: Up to 10 tags, separated by commas.
lessons.archiveIntro: An archived lesson is no longer searchable and can no longer be changed.
lessons.draftNote: A lesson is saved as a draft; publish it to make it searchable.
lessons.publishedEditNote: This lesson is published: changes are searchable at once.

search.title: Lesson search
search.intro: Published lessons of every transformation in your scope.
search.prompt: Enter words or a tag, then search.
search.scopeNote: Only published lessons of business units in your scope are searched.
search.emptyBody: Try other words, or a tag.
